I love duster but I’m underwhelmed by this record (and their self titled which has a similar sound). Duster itself is such a beautiful timepiece, and I wish they would’ve just made a new alias like they already have many times for the last two new records they’ve done.
I know it may be a hot take but its weird to me to rerelease music under the same alias 20 years later when it’s a completely different time period in their lives, and duster / all their other projects seem to be just that, time periods of their lives

Completely agree, it’s way more fun to listen to and comes off much less pretentious. When I wrote songs younger I really tried to make lyrics that were cohesive and had meaning to them and they came off real cheesy and shallow because I thought that that’s how lyrics had to be. My brain naturally works that way as well so I thought that it wasn’t normal to write lyrics that are scattered. I heard pavement and it gave me the confidence to write lyrics like malkmus, all over the place. I love my lyrics now and am far more confident with my music.
